g.title: Raspberry Pi · physical deployment host Physical host: DNS, Caddy, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and all server volumes live here. APP is the nested process boundary. Clients remain outside this host. Router supplies Wi-Fi/DHCP; no router configuration or internet port forwarding required.

Spring Boot · Pi app container Deployment boundary: app container on Raspberry Pi, one Java 25 JVM. Port 8080 is private to Compose. Caddy forwards HTTP to app:8080. Internal arrows are in-process calls or port implementations.
Controllers Delivery grouping only. Each domain controller constructor receives its own facade interface; maps transport input/output and performs no service orchestration or persistence.

text.tspan: Delivery grouping only. Each domain controller constructor receives its own facade interface; maps transport input/output and performs no service orchestration or persistence.

g.title: Accounts and Access Domain owns facade interfaces, focused services, DAO interfaces, model and persistence implementations. Other domains cannot import its internals.
Groceries Domain owns facade interfaces, focused services, DAO interfaces, model and persistence implementations. Other domains cannot import its internals.

Household browser · laptop Runs on each laptop. DNS server address is saved in OS network settings. Public household root is trusted in OS/browser certificate storage. Browser stores session cookie; renders Spanish pages + htmx. Caddy runs on the Pi.

text.tspan: Runs on each laptop. DNS server
address is saved in OS network

g.title: iPhone app · each phone SwiftUI runs on each iPhone. Pi DNS IP is saved in Wi-Fi settings for the household network. Public root profile is installed and full trust enabled in iOS Settings. URLSession uses that trust; hs_sess_ token lives in Keychain. Allow Local Network access.

text.tspan: SwiftUI runs on each iPhone. Pi DNS IP
is saved in Wi-Fi settings for the

g.title: Agent processes · laptop Runs on the household laptop. OS network settings point DNS to the Pi. Public CA PEM is stored locally; runtime trust configuration points to it. API key lives in process environment. HTTPS /mcp reaches Caddy on the Pi.

text.tspan: Runs on the household laptop. OS
network settings point DNS to the Pi.
Public CA PEM is stored locally;

g.title: Pi-hole DNS · Raspberry Pi Pi-hole dns container on the Raspberry Pi. LAN UDP/TCP 53. home-companion.home.arpa maps to the active Caddy host IP; record and upstream DNS settings persist in dns_config mounted at /etc/pihole. Each client manually selects Pi DNS. Router DHCP stays in place.

text.tspan: Pi-hole dns container on the Raspberry

g.title: Caddy proxy · Raspberry Pi proxy container on Raspberry Pi. LAN 443 HTTPS; 80 redirects. Read-only Caddyfile mounted at /etc/caddy/Caddyfile defines tls internal and reverse_proxy app:8080; blocks Actuator. Internal CA issues/renews certificates using caddy_data. No DNS or trust installation on clients through this proxy.

text.tspan: proxy container on Raspberry Pi. LAN

g.title: caddy_data · Pi disk Docker named volume on Raspberry Pi disk, mounted only into Caddy at /data. Persists private CA keys and server certificates. Export only public root at /data/caddy/pki/authorities/local/root.crt for client trust. Losing this CA requires trusting a new root on clients.

text.tspan: Docker named volume on Raspberry Pi
disk, mounted only into Caddy at

g.title: Security authenticate(request); authorize(module, operation). AccessFacade injected. Reject invalid credentials (401) or denied access (403) before controller/tool dispatch. Resolve live account state, module grants and key caps on every protected request; recheck each MCP tools/call. Explicit public login/registration routes call AccountFacade; no module access until approved and authorized. Browser failures use login/state pages.

text.tspan: or denied access (403) before controller/tool dispatch.

g.title: Web Adapter GroceryWebController(GroceryReadFacade, GroceryWriteFacade); AccountWebController(AccountFacade). Domain-specific controllers delegate to facades after Security permits the operation. Thymeleaf views, htmx fragments and redirects.

text.tspan: to facades after Security permits the operation. Thymeleaf views, htmx

g.title: Phone API GroceryApiController(GroceryReadFacade, GroceryWriteFacade); AccountApiController(AccountFacade). Domain-specific controllers map REST DTOs to domain-owned facade inputs. Server-resolved access only; no caller-supplied grants.

text.tspan: DTOs to domain-owned facade inputs. Server-resolved access only; no

g.title: Agent Tools GroceryTools(GroceryReadFacade, GroceryWriteFacade). Authorized list calls use read facade; addStock uses write facade. EDIT plus READ_WRITE key and current owner grant required; tools never call services or DAOs directly.

text.tspan: Authorized list calls use read facade; addStock uses write
facade. EDIT plus READ_WRITE key and current owner grant

g.title: PostgreSQL 18 · Pi container postgres container on Raspberry Pi. pgdata is a Docker volume on Pi disk. Accounts, grants, hashed credentials, current groceries and 24 h deduplication. Port 5432 stays private to Compose.

text.tspan: postgres container on Raspberry Pi. pgdata is a Docker volume on Pi disk. Accounts,
grants, hashed credentials, current groceries and 24 h deduplication. Port 5432 stays

g.title: icons volume · Pi disk Grocery-owned LocalImageStore persists validated PNG/JPEG files in the icons volume on this host. Accounts module catalogue stores URLs; it does not depend on grocery image implementation.

text.tspan: Grocery-owned LocalImageStore persists validated PNG/JPEG files in the icons
volume on this host. Accounts module catalogue stores URLs; it does not depend

g.title: One-time setup and persistent state Household administrator configures Pi DNS records and Caddyfile on the Pi. On each laptop/iPhone: save Pi IP as DNS server and trust the public CA certificate. DNS queries go directly to Pi-hole; HTTPS goes to Caddy. No CA private key leaves the Pi. Keep Pi address stable and outside conflicting DHCP allocations; do not enable a second DHCP server. Selecting a component shows only its incoming/outgoing arrows, including owned children. V2: solid arrows are calls; dashed implementation arrows point from concrete DAO to interface. Return values follow calls in reverse. Cards are proposed types, not implemented Java. Each code is the separate component ID shown on its card. Facades compose one domain only; no generic Shared contracts or Infrastructure adapters module.

DNS queries go directly to Pi-hole; HTTPS goes to Caddy. No CA private key leaves the Pi. Keep Pi address stable and outside conflicting DHCP allocations; do not enable a second DHCP server. Facades compose one domain only; no generic Shared contracts or

g.title: Account / Access Facades DefaultAccountFacade implements AccountFacade; DefaultAccessFacade implements AccessFacade. Constructor-injected IdentityService, CredentialService and PermissionService interfaces. Account facade coordinates registration, approval, credentials and module catalogue; access facade coordinates authentication and authorization. Only Accounts and Access services; transactional account changes. Access decisions stay at the security boundary.

text.tspan: CredentialService and PermissionService interfaces. Account facade

g.title: Grocery Facades DefaultGroceryFacade implements GroceryReadFacade, GroceryWriteFacade. Constructor-injected ProductService, StockService, DesiredService, ImageService. addStock(command): result coordinates product resolution and stock update in one transaction; shoppingList() combines targets and stock via a pure calculator. Groceries services only.

Identity Service DefaultIdentityService implements IdentityService. IdentityService(UserDao dao). Responsibility: user state and profile; approve(userId). Uses only domain-owned DAO interfaces; no controller or concrete JPA dependency.
UserDao interface interface UserDao: focused persistence operations for user state and profile. Owned by ACC; domain values in/out, no JPA entities or generic cross-domain CRUD interface.

text.tspan: operations for user state and profile. Owned
by ACC; domain values in/out, no JPA

g.title: JpaUserDao JpaUserDao implements UserDao. Domain-local infrastructure.persistence; private Spring Data repository and JPA entities. Parameterized queries; participates in facade transaction. No other domain tables or JPA adapter imports.

Credential Service DefaultCredentialService implements CredentialService. CredentialService(CredentialDao dao). Responsibility: credential lifecycle; resolve(token), issue(), revoke(). Uses only domain-owned DAO interfaces; no controller or concrete JPA dependency.
CredentialDao interface interface CredentialDao: focused persistence operations for credential lifecycle. Owned by ACC; domain values in/out, no JPA entities or generic cross-domain CRUD interface.

text.tspan: by ACC; domain values in/out, no JPA

g.title: JpaStockDao JpaStockDao implements StockDao. Domain-local infrastructure.persistence; private Spring Data repository and JPA entities. Parameterized queries; participates in facade transaction. No other domain tables or JPA adapter imports.

text.tspan: private Spring Data repository and JPA

g.title: Desired Service DefaultDesiredService implements DesiredService. DesiredService(DesiredDao dao). Responsibility: desired quantity targets; targets(), setTarget(itemId,quantity). Uses only domain-owned DAO interfaces; no controller or concrete JPA dependency.
DesiredDao interface interface DesiredDao: focused persistence operations for desired quantity targets. Owned by GRO; domain values in/out, no JPA entities or generic cross-domain CRUD interface.

text.tspan: Owned by GRO; domain values in/out, no JPA

g.title: JpaDesiredDao JpaDesiredDao implements DesiredDao. Domain-local infrastructure.persistence; private Spring Data repository and JPA entities. Parameterized queries; participates in facade transaction. No other domain tables or JPA adapter imports.

text.tspan: private Spring Data repository and JPA

g.title: Image Service DefaultImageService implements ImageService. ImageService(ImageStore store). Validates uploads and coordinates image storage through the grocery-owned ImageStore interface.
ImageStore interface interface ImageStore: store(validatedImage), read(imageRef). Grocery-owned file persistence port; returns grocery image values. No account or credential responsibility.
LocalImageStore LocalImageStore implements ImageStore. Grocery infrastructure.files adapter. Re-encodes validated images to PNG/JPEG and stores files in the icons volume.
